items.title: Six New U-Boot Flaws Could Let Malicious Images Crash Devices or Run Code at Boot
items.description: Researchers at firmware security firm Binarly have found six new flaws in U-Boot, the small program that starts up hardware as varied as home routers, smart cameras, and the management chips inside data-center servers. items.title: Money launderer accused of stealing seized crypto while in prison
